text: Haan bhai, jaldi se transfer karo. Yeh log pata nahi kahan dekar chale gaye. Main building D mein rehta hoon aur inhone galat building, matlab building B mein deliver kar diya hai. Mujhe abhi ke abhi isko theek karwana hai, kisi ko bhejo jo wahan se nikal kar mere paas sahi se deliver kare. Ekdum urgent hai yaar!
